messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.sse-edge.eu-west-1 p99 latency breached 5.0s across 3 clusters. Auto-page oncall. Links: https://grafana.redwood/streams/p95-p99, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/streaming-incidents
oncall_mx: I'm on it, paging SRE.
sre_jamie: I see the spike on p95/p99, tail latency jumping at ~12:30UTC. Repro window matches recent deploy? Checking deploy bot...
incident-bot: Deploy 'runtime/stream-proxy:2026.3.8' rolled at 11:58UTC to eu-west-1 (canary->all). No rollback detected.
eng_runtime_lee: I rolled that canary earlier. No config changes that should affect chunking, but we did bump keepalive aggressiveness. Looking at edge proxy logs now.
infra_kate: Any customer reports? support_clara: Support is already seeing ~6 tickets flagged by customer-alert-bot for slow stream starts and intermittent stalls. Two customers reported reconnect loops.
pm_anya: Prioritize customer-impacting mitigation; alert exec if we hit 30 min.
sre_jamie: Quick triage: metrics show an increase in proxy write stalls and an elevated number of client slow consumers. The backend model inference p95 is stable. Tail appears at the edge/proxy layer.
sre_jamie: Logs snippet (edge proxy):
```
2026-03-15T12:30:42Z proxy-edge[write] WARN write stalled for conn=abc123 after 4.8s
2026-03-15T12:30:43Z proxy-edge[conn] ERR socket EAGAIN while flushing chunk
2026-03-15T12:30:44Z proxy-edge[conn] WARN backpressure window exceeded client=10.2.3.45
```
eng_runtime_lee: That looks like client backpressure + proxy buffer sizing. Did we change chunk flush thresholds? I toggled 'buffered_chunk_threshold_ms' to 1200ms in canary. Might be too aggressive for slow consumers.
sre_jamie: Rollback suggestion: revert buffer threshold to previous 200ms on eu-west-1 for immediate mitigation. That should reduce head-of-line stalls.
oncall_mx: Who can perform quick rollback?
eng_runtime_lee: I can roll it, prepping command.
eng_runtime_lee: Command to patch config in k8s:
```
kubectl -n streaming set configmap proxy-config --from-literal=buffered_chunk_threshold_ms=200 --context=eu-west-1
kubectl rollout restart deploy/stream-proxy -n streaming --context=eu-west-1
```
infra_kate: Also recommend increasing proxy write timeout temporarily from 30s -> 60s to avoid premature disconnects during mitigation.
support_clara: Notifying affected customers that we're actively mitigating and may see brief reconnects. Template: "We're investigating streaming stalls in EU region; mitigations in progress — will update in 15m." :eyes:
pm_anya: Good. Use the incident template and log affected org IDs.
customer_alert_bot: Customer impact summary: 12 orgs experiencing >=10% failed streaming starts; 3 orgs reporting reconnect loops. Affected features: live-chat, streaming-embeds.
sre_jamie: Rolling the config now (eu-west-1). Patch applied, restarting pods. Rolling restart going node-by-node to keep capacity.
sre_jamie: Restart output: 5/5 pods restarted, healthchecks passing, stream open success rate improving.
sre_jamie: Early telemetry shows p95 reduced from 3.2s->1.1s and p99 down to 1.9s. Still watching for tail outliers.
eng_runtime_lee: Leaving a hotfix flag and reverting the canary change in our feature branch. We'll run smaller threshold experiments in staging.
infra_kate: I also cleared edge proxies' write buffers on a node that had high memory usage: `curl -XPOST http://proxy-node-03.internal/flush`
support_clara: Customers confirm improvement in chat flow. One large customer still seeing occasional 5s stalls — collecting client-side traces.
sre_jamie: Next mitigation if rollback wasn't enough: enable routing fallback to dedicated capacity for heavy orgs (route-by-org-id, soft-failover). Command (manual):
```
redwoodctl traffic-route set --org=org-42 --route=dedicated-eu-west-1 --weight=100
```
eng_runtime_lee: We'll keep that ready but avoid global reroute unless we see another spike. Also monitoring connection churn: `netstat -anp | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l` on edge nodes shows high established sockets but not exploding.
pm_anya: Assigning SRE ownership for the incident -> @sre_jamie. Support will patch customers. Engineering runtime to lead root cause once stabilized.
sre_jamie: I'll own postmortem and RCA. Immediate action items: (1) keep rollback for 60m, (2) watch p99, (3) escalate to oncall infra if socket pool saturates.
eng_runtime_lee: Noted. I'll revert the PR and open a follow-up to add automated canary guardrail for buffer tuning.
infra_kate: Adding a short-term alert change: create an alert for proxy chunk-queue-length > 100 for 2m to page infra.
customer_alert_bot: Update sent to affected orgs at 12:48UTC.
support_clara: Continuing to triage remaining customer traces, will post in thread if we see client-specific patterns.
sre_jamie: p95/p99 now stable for 10 minutes, closing the emergency page in 10m if no regression. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
oncall_mx: Thanks all. Handoff to SRE for RCA and to PM for customer comms.
pm_anya: I'll prepare incident summary and coordination for tomorrow's all-hands.
sre_jamie: Early hypothesis: aggressive canary change to buffered chunk threshold interacted poorly with a subset of slow consumer clients + proxy buffer limits, causing stalls at the edge. Postmortem will include timeline, config diff, and remediation plan (canary guardrails + auto-fallback routing).
sre_jamie: Closing note: if anyone sees a recurrence ping oncall. Good work everyone. :clap:
